title: Nottingham Forest aim to comply with UEFA multi-club ownership rules after Europa League progress
content:
But they must be prepared for the possibility, if they are not to fall foul of the regulations – as Premier League rivals Crystal Palace did this season, when they found themselves relegated to a place in the Conference League – to Forest’s advantage, as they were promoted to play in the Europa League.

Changes to the club’s board have been registered with Companies House (the executive agency of the British government that maintains the register of companies), with Mighael Dugher, Simon Forster, and Jonathan Owen all temporarily removed, as was the case last season.
